name: schedule
title: Schedule
description: Events placed in time: a day or a week as hours down a rail, a month as weeks of lanes, or an agenda.
use: Things booked at a time: meetings, appointments, shifts, talks at a conference, a team's calendar. A day or a few days show the hours, with each event as tall as it lasts and what lasts whole days in the band above them; a month shows each day's events in lanes; an agenda lists them by day. Write each event's title and time as text, so it reads without the drawing. A schedule-view, driven by the schedule behavior, lets the reader move through the periods and switch views; it does not edit, store or repeat events.

instead.when: The spans are compared on one shared scale, one row to a thing, such as phases of a project
A reader picks a day, or a range of days, from a month
The events are moments in the order they happened, with no length
The events are read as rows of facts and sorted, not placed in time

classes.name: schedule
classes.description: The hours from --schedule-from to --schedule-to, each --schedule-hour tall: a rail of labels at the start, then one column for each day

classes.name: schedule-now
classes.description: Draws an ink line with a dot at --now through the day marked aria-current="date", or through every day when none is, and a hairline through the other days

classes.name: schedule-rail
classes.description: The labels of the hours, one item to an hour from --schedule-from to --schedule-to, each centered on its hairline. Hide it with aria-hidden: the events say their times in words

classes.name: schedule-day
classes.description: One day's column, for several days side by side: an optional schedule-heading over its schedule-events. Mark today with aria-current="date". A schedule of one day may leave it out

classes.name: schedule-heading
classes.description: The name of a day, over its column, in muted ink; today's takes the strong ink

classes.name: schedule-events
classes.description: The events of one day, in order of time, on the scale's hairlines: one at every hour and one down the day's start

classes.name: schedule-event
classes.description: One event from --start to --end, in lane --lane of --lanes: a quiet sheet of tinted ink with a rounded ink bar inside its start, a pixel clear of the hairlines. Put it on the list item, or on a link or a button inside one. A short event keeps one line

classes.name: schedule-title
classes.description: What the event is: one line that ends in an ellipsis. It stands in an event wherever the event is: on the hours, in a month, a list or an agenda

classes.name: schedule-time
classes.description: When it is, written with <time> elements: a quiet line under the title, or beside it in a short event when both fit. It stands in an event wherever the event is: on the hours, in a month, a list or an agenda

classes.name: schedule-event-lane
classes.description: In a lane instead of on the hours: --span days from day --column, on lane --lane, one line high. For an all-day band, a month and a list of events

classes.name: schedule-event-continued
classes.description: A piece of an event that began before: on the hours its top is square, in a lane its start, and it has no bar

classes.name: schedule-event-continues
classes.description: A piece of an event that goes on after: on the hours its bottom is square, in a lane its end

classes.name: schedule-event-plain
classes.description: A short event in a month or a list: no sheet, a dot for the bar, then its time and its title

classes.name: schedule-event-category
classes.description: The sheet, bar and words of the category set by a category-<name> class on it or around it

classes.name: schedule-allday
classes.description: The band under the headings for what lasts whole days, across the day columns: each day names its column with --column and the schedule says how many in --schedule-days. Holds a schedule-allday-label and lane events

classes.name: schedule-allday-label
classes.description: The band's name in the rail's column, such as "All day"; aria-hidden, with the band named by its aria-label

classes.name: schedule-month
classes.description: A month: schedule-weekdays over schedule-weeks. In a narrow room each day shows a dot for each of its events instead of lanes

classes.name: schedule-weekdays
classes.description: The names of the weekdays over the weeks; aria-hidden, since each day's number is named in full

classes.name: schedule-weekday
classes.description: One weekday's name

classes.name: schedule-weeks
classes.description: The weeks, in order

classes.name: schedule-week
classes.description: A week: seven days, the numbers on the first row, --lanes rows of events and a row for the more buttons. Write each day, then the events that start on it, then its more button, so they read in the order of the days

classes.name: schedule-date
classes.description: A day: a cell from the top to the bottom of the week in column --column, with --count its number of events. Mark today with aria-current="date"

classes.name: schedule-date-outside
classes.description: A day of the month before or after: a quieter number on a faint tray

classes.name: schedule-date-number
classes.description: The day's number, a round button that opens the day; its accessible name is the whole date and its count of events. Today's is ink

classes.name: schedule-more
classes.description: The rest of a day's events past its lanes, on the week's last row in column --column: opens a popover that lists the day's events. Its accessible name says how many and which day

classes.name: schedule-list
classes.description: Events in the order they come, as lane events one above the other: a day's in its popover, each day's in the agenda

classes.name: schedule-agenda
classes.description: The period's days that have events, one to a row: the date at the start and a schedule-list beside it, or over it in a narrow room

classes.name: schedule-agenda-day
classes.description: One day of the agenda; mark today with aria-current="date"

classes.name: schedule-agenda-date
classes.description: The day's date, at the start of its row or over a day's list in a popover; today's takes the strong ink

classes.name: schedule-view
classes.description: A schedule the reader works: a schedule-view-header over a schedule-view-body, driven by the schedule behavior

classes.name: schedule-view-header
classes.description: The controls: today, previous and next, the period's name and the view switch, with the name on a line of its own in a narrow room

classes.name: schedule-view-title
classes.description: The period on show, such as "November 2026"; mark it aria-live="polite" so a move is heard

classes.name: schedule-view-previous
classes.description: Moves back by the view's period

classes.name: schedule-view-next
classes.description: Moves on by the view's period

classes.name: schedule-view-today
classes.description: Moves to the period that holds today

classes.name: schedule-view-switch
classes.description: Holds the radios that choose the view, with the values day, week, month and agenda; a segmented control

classes.name: schedule-view-body
classes.description: Where the behavior writes the period: a schedule for a day or a week, a schedule-month or a schedule-agenda

states.name: current
states.description: The event in progress, or the one open beside the schedule: an ink sheet

states.name: today
states.description: Today: its heading takes the strong ink and schedule-now draws its line through it

states.name: today
states.description: Today: its date takes the strong ink

properties.name: --schedule-from
properties.description: The first hour, from 0 to 24; fractions work

properties.name: --schedule-rail
properties.description: The width of the rail of labels

properties.name: --schedule-color
properties.description: The ink the events are tinted and edged with

properties.name: --now
properties.description: The hour of the line of schedule-now, such as 13.5 for half past one

properties.name: --lane
properties.description: Where the event stands among events that overlap it, from 0 at the start; 0 by default

properties.name: --lanes
properties.description: How many events stand side by side where this one does; 1 by default

properties.name: --schedule-days
properties.description: How many day columns stand side by side, for a schedule with an all-day band; 1 by default

properties.name: --column
properties.description: In a lane, the day the event starts on in its row, from 1; on a schedule-day, schedule-date or schedule-more, its column

properties.name: --span
properties.description: In a lane, how many days the event covers in its row; 1 by default

properties.name: --lanes
properties.description: How many lanes of events a week shows; 3 by default

properties.name: --count
properties.description: How many events the day holds, drawn as up to three dots in a narrow month

example:
1. 9 AM
  2. 10 AM
  3. 11 AM
  4. 12 PM

  1. Standup

    9:00 – 9:30

  2. Design review

    10:00 – 11:30

keyboard.action: Moves through the header's controls, then each day's number, its events and its more button in the order of the days
Activates a control: previous, today and next move by the view's period, a day's number opens the day, an event does what the page gives it, and a more button opens the day's list
Choose a view among the switch's radios, as radios do
Closes a day's list, as any popover does

platform.fallback: A month keeps its lanes at every width, and an agenda keeps the date beside its events

platform.feature: CSS subgrid, for the all-day band
platform.fallback: The band's events do not line up with the day columns under it
